content: Public ATS JSON endpoints, no auth: Greenhouse GET boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{board}/jobs?content=true (no filtering); Lever GET api.lever.co/v0/postings/{company}?mode=json (supports team/location/commitment filters, skip/limit); Ashby GET api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{name}?includeCompensation=true. No documented rate limits; designed for syndication.
